title: Credit Economics: Stop Streaming Static Catalog Feeds

steps.prompt: Data 360 credits are burning down early each month. An audit finds 50 streaming connectors on product catalog tables that change about once a week, while scarce credit headroom is needed for real-time behavioral streams. What refactor is required?

options.label: Move slow-changing catalog ingestion from continuous streaming connectors to scheduled batch ingestion
options.rationale: Streaming Everything on near-static sources wastes continuous compute credits. Batch ingestion matches catalog change cadence and reserves streaming budget for true real-time signals.

options.label: Buy 10× more credits and leave the streaming topology unchanged
options.rationale: Purchasing capacity without fixing waste violates Cost Optimization and merely delays the next credit cliff.

options.label: Disable encryption on catalog objects to reduce compute cost
options.rationale: Weakening encryption to save credits destroys Trust and compliance boundaries; credit governance must not sacrifice security controls.
